messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 2410001234 created — high P95 latency observed for omni-v3 quant variant in us-west across a subset of enterprise keys. Automated alert triggered.
samir: saw the alert, pulling traces. P95 spiking to ~3.2s on generate tokens for keys flagged as heavy. Not global but consistent across a tenant group.
elaine: oncall here. paging in progress. tagging infra + model-ops. @rafa can you join? need confirmation if newest quant rollout started in us-west last 30m.
rafa: I rolled out omni-v3-quant-2026-03-15 to canary then prod 18m ago; monitoring green initially. seeing CPU memory climb on hosts serving that variant for long contexts.
samir: copying traces — top stack is kvcache miss + repeated recompile hits on kernels. suspect quant path triggers a kernel slowpath for longer seqs.
mohit: adding logs from runtime: ```
[2026-03-15T21:12:41Z] model=omni-v3-quant variant=quant-2026-03-15 seq=2048 host=gpu-12 latency=3120ms
[2026-03-15T21:12:41Z] kernel=matmul_fallback reason=tile-mismatch
```
samir: that aligns. impact pattern: heavy enterprise keys (customer_id: 9xxx) with long context windows. Not CPU saturation but repeated kernel fallback causing tail latency.
elaine: customer-impact? support-lead, any active P1s? which customers are hitting this? need immediate mitigation plan.
support-lead: support notes — two customer incidents opened (Cust-Delta, Cust-Lumen). They report timeouts and user-visible slowdowns. CS is on standby, ETA to customers 15m.
samir: mitigation options: 1) temporarily block omni-v3-quant for those tenant keys and route to omni-v3-stable (float16) 2) apply key-level emergency reduced token quotas / per-key rate-limit 3) roll back quant variant globally to previous canary.
elaine: let's do minimal blast radius: route affected keys off quant to stable variant and apply soft rate-limit while we assess. Can we do keywise reroute without a full deploy?
rafa: yes, we have route overrides. running command now:
```
redwoodctl routing override create --model omni-v3 --from-variant quant-2026-03-15 --to-variant stable-2026-02-28 --filter "customer_id in (9001,9002,9003)" --reason "emergency latency mitigation"
```
deploy-bot: routing override applied (id: rout-241000A). propagating to edge config. expecting effect within 20s.
ops-bot: config propagation complete to 6 edge nodes. 95% of traffic for those keys now hitting stable-2026-02-28.
mohit: verify metrics — P95 for those keys dropped from 3.2s -> 520ms within 45s. nice.
support-lead: informing CS — status update: traffic rerouted to stable variant. we're seeing partial recovery, pushing note to Cust-Delta and Cust-Lumen.
elaine: also enable emergency per-key token throttle to reduce risk of further tail load while we investigate long-term fix. command:
```
redwoodctl quota set --key 9001 --tokens-per-minute 120 --reason "emergency throttle"
redwoodctl quota set --key 9002 --tokens-per-minute 60
```
rafa: quotas applied. Telemetry shows throughput fall ~18% for those keys.
samir: good. Next step: decide if we should roll back the quant variant globally or pin and diagnose kernel mismatch. I want a forensics dump from the nodes that hit the fallback.
elaine: samir to own oncall incident lead. rafa and mohit to collect runtime traces and kernel selection logs. samir will coordinate rollback decision and comms. I'll start a bridge.
support-lead: CS drafted interim message: "We have temporarily routed your requests to a stable model variant to restore responsiveness; working on permanent fix."
deploy-bot: restart for variant quant-2026-03-15 scheduled? none. no changes made to variant binary.
mohit: forensic dumps attached to incident page (links). quick grep shows mismatch appears when seq > 1024 and kvcache size > X which triggers a different matmul tiling. I can reproduce locally with a long prompt.
samir: based on early repro, I recommend shelving quant-2026-03-15 from production rollout until kernel path fix lands. Plan: mark variant inactive for routing by default and keep it available for testing. Execute:
```
redwoodctl variant deactivate --model omni-v3 --variant quant-2026-03-15 --scope production --reason "shelve until kernel-fix"
```
elaine: if we deactivate, we need to ensure no sudden fallback to older codepaths. confirm that stable variant capacity can handle baseline traffic.
rafa: stable capa headroom is ~40% in us-west. safe.
samir: proceeding with deactivate.
deploy-bot: variant quant-2026-03-15 marked inactive in control plane. propagation to routing plane started.
ops-bot: routing plane update complete. controller re-evaluated policies — any request without explicit override will not route to quant-2026-03-15.
mohit: monitoring — no requests hitting quant variant for 10s. overall latency normalized for affected tenants.
support-lead: CS notified customers that we've shelved the quant rollout and routed them to stable. asking for confirmation that UX is restored.
elaine: opening a postmortem ticket and tagging model-ops + runtime-compiler. timeline: - 21:12 alert; 21:15 routing override; 21:18 quotas set; 21:22 variant deactivate; 21:28 steady state. We'll assign actions.
samir: oncall handoff at 22:00 to night team. @rafa, please summarize root cause hypotheses and next steps in the incident doc before handoff.
rafa: will add details: likely kernel tiling mismatch for long sequences on quantized kernels; steps: reproduce, add kernel guard or fallback detection, re-run microbenchmarks, patch runtime and run canary.
mohit: I'll prep a temporary metric to detect fallback hotspots and alert if P95 > 1s for >3m for any tenant after re-enable.
support-lead: CS requested a one-pager for impacted customers with timeline and mitigations. I'll push that and share for review.
elaine: any further live mitigations needed? otherwise I'll close active incident channel and convert to postmortem thread.
samir: nothing else. leaving final note: severity reduced to Sev3, customer-visible impact mitigated by routing and quotas. continuing investigation.
incident-bot: Incident 2410001234 status changed to "mitigated" by elaine at 2410001987. postmortem ticket created: PM-2410001234. :white_check_mark:
